purpose: Compare the latest official monthly average interest rate for one Treasury security description with the prior month's rate and return a bounded directional signal.

decision_policy.rising: Latest rate minus prior-month rate is at least minChangeBps.
decision_policy.falling: Latest rate minus prior-month rate is at most negative minChangeBps.
decision_policy.unchanged: Absolute change is smaller than minChangeBps.
decision_policy.human_review: Security is unavailable, ambiguous, lacks two monthly observations, or has unusable rate data.

claim_boundaries: the result is a mechanical comparison of official monthly average-interest-rate records
it is not an interest-rate forecast, investment advice, monetary-policy prediction, or recommendation
a two-month directional comparison is not a long-term trend determination
